messages.author: 45d4b5de643596b5
messages.subject: PARDISO License Academic Free
parts:
Hi everyone,

For my master's thesis I am trying to fit a spatial model to a brain emotion processing dataset. As I need to load approximately 400GB into R, it would be useful to load the PARDISO package to speed up computations I want to do with BayesfMRI. Are these licenses still handed out to students for free? I read conflicting messages online. After filling out the form online, I did not get an e-mail on my university account. Would I need to contact Olaf Schenk about this?

Best,

Bas

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] PARDISO License Academic Free
parts:
Yes, use r4.2 and the most recent y testing version. Use university email
Follow instructions on
